info.name: LendPay API v1.0
info.description:
# LendPay API v1.0

LendPay is a modern Loan Management System (LMS) API designed for microfinance institutions, SACCOs, digital lenders and financial institutions.

## Features

- Authentication & Authorization
- User Management
- Customer Management
- Loan Products
- Loan Applications
- Credit Assessments
- Loan Approvals
- Loan Disbursement
- Loan Portfolio Management
- Repayments
- Collections
- Penalty Engine
- Overdue Processing
- Write-offs
- Loan Ledger
- Notifications
- Reports
- Dashboard Analytics
- Audit Logs

## Authentication

Authenticate using:

Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}

The Login endpoint returns a JWT token which should be saved as {{accessToken}} in your environment.

## Environment Variables

baseUrl
accessToken
customerId
loanProductId
applicationId
guarantorId
loanId
repaymentId
collectionActivityId
notificationId
userId

## Version

v1.0.0

© 2026 LendPay
